note_on_the_54: The audit enumerates every delete target raised this round. The sandbox message for the rejected command itself listed 5 blocked paths; summing the glob expansions of all delete commands issued this round gives 52 item-instances (26 distinct paths). The reviewer's tool counted 54, which this audit could not reproduce exactly -- therefore the COMPLETE 124-file inventory of stage4_blender is included below so no file is left unclassified.

DELETE_TARGETS_THAT_WOULD_HAVE_HIT_NON_T.severity: none remaining -- every target above classifies as CURRENT_TASK_TEMP

P0_INCIDENT.what: event 3 used the glob 'RSSF_BEFORE_*.png'. That glob ALSO matches the deliverable composites 'RSSF_BEFORE_AFTER_*.png', so 4 finished Stage-4B deliverables were destroyed together with the temp frames.
P0_INCIDENT.recovery: regenerated from the FROZEN baseline (RIGHT_HAND_ENGINEERING_STAGE4A_R2.blend) + the RSSF blend + CAMS.json; all four are present on disk again and byte-current
P0_INCIDENT.root_cause: deliverable names and temp names shared a namespace inside one directory, so a prefix glob could not separate them
P0_INCIDENT.fix_adopted: _tmp/ scratch directory; temp artefacts no longer share a directory with deliverables, and no wildcard delete is used
